# Jurisdiction Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/JurisdictionTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, time-scoped fact that a place was governed by a particular polity over an interval — a sovereignty or administrative jurisdiction claim. Non-functional on the place: contested sovereignty (e.g. Crimea-class) is modelled as multiple co-existing JurisdictionTenures, each standpoint-indexed and confidence-weighted, never collapsing to a single winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify a time-scoped sovereignty/administrative-jurisdiction fact when period, standpoint, or contestation matter.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the simple, uncontested case (the flat [`gmeow:containedInPlace`](../properties/gmeow-containedInPlace.md) is the 80% shortcut) and avoid collapsing contested claims — model each as a standpoint-indexed [`JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint [`JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md), set [`gmeow:jurisdictionPlace`](../properties/gmeow-jurisdictionPlace.md) and [`gmeow:jurisdictionPolity`](../properties/gmeow-jurisdictionPolity.md), scope with [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md), and index competing claims with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md).

### Examples

- ex:jt a [`gmeow:JurisdictionTenure`](gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md); [`gmeow:jurisdictionPlace`](../properties/gmeow-jurisdictionPlace.md) ex:crimea; [`gmeow:jurisdictionPolity`](../properties/gmeow-jurisdictionPolity.md) ex:stateA; [`gmeow:accordingTo`](../properties/gmeow-accordingTo.md) ex:standpointA.
